question: Mr. Z starts from Point Y and drives 12 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 2 km, turns right and drives 1 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. Не takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point X. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Mr. Z starts from Point Y and drives 12 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 2 km, turns right and drives 1 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. Не takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ae52a8e269624e7002bc427962180314ec09a10bc16b7068067ee2893c21b5f.png] 

Thus, Z has to drive 16km east to reach point Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
